plainText:
Samara Naeymi is a voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Naeymi became an actress as an adult, but only got minor roles initially. She then started getting more significant roles when she voiced supporting characters in several cartoon series, including English-dubbed versions of international shows. She joined during , most notably voicing Kalos Elite Four member and secret Team Flare agent Malva, as well as character of the day Jean. Naeymi currently resides in New York City, New York.
